title: Filming: Whatever Gets You Thru The Night by John Lennon | 1974
content:
Footage was filmed for a promotional clip for John Lennon’s single ‘Whatever Gets You Thru The Night’ on 17 October 1974.

A film crew led by director Peter Cooper accompanied Lennon in a taxi cab, stopping at several locations including Central Park Zoo and Tiffany’s.
